_comment: Admin sticker catalog. Add entries here to offer more stickers. 'source' can be a drawable resource name (e.g. sticker_heart), an 'asset://stickers/<file>.png' path for a bundled PNG/GIF, or an 'https://…' URL for a hosted image (e.g. on R2/Firebase). Drop PNG/GIF files next to this file and reference them as asset://stickers/<file>.
